name: padaria-cozinha
description: Tela da cozinha (TV/Android) empacotada com Capacitor

scripts.android:add: npm run vendor && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android-tv.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo "APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
scripts.apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.apk:debug:win: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
